scope: One read-only selected-site plan, not a load test

Plans.Filter: ((date >= '1900-01-01'::date) AND (date <= '2100-12-31'::date) AND ((COALESCE(source_module, ''::character varying))::text !~ '_person$'::text) AND ((COALESCE(source_module, ''::character varying))::text <> ALL ('{imprest,imprest_requests,document_imprest,document_imprest_requests,plot_commissions,plot_registry_payments}'::text[])))

((NOT is_split) AND ((debit <> '0'::numeric) OR (credit <> '0'::numeric)) AND (CASE WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM (raw_mode)::text), ''::text), 'CASH'::text)) = 'CASH'::text) THEN 'cash'::text ELSE 'bank'::text END = 'cash'::text))

Plans.Index Cond: ((organization_id = 1) AND (site_id = a.site_id) AND (holder_key = a.holder_key) AND (id > a.aligned_id))
